source: Aviance Evidence-Based SEO Audit & Scoring Methodology v2.0

provenance.weights: VERIFIED FROM SOURCE AUDITS (byte-identical in all four)
provenance.check_points: DERIVED (PART D: v1.0 rubric, not recovered analyst constants)

provenance.methodology: Independently validated evidence-first scoring with Google Search Central alignment

technical.name: HTTPS on all pages
technical.reason: Browsers flag HTTP pages as not secure; HTTPS is part of Google's page experience guidance.
technical.fix: Serve every page over HTTPS and redirect HTTP to HTTPS with a 301.

technical.name: HTTP to HTTPS redirect
technical.reason: Without a permanent redirect, HTTP and HTTPS versions compete as duplicates.
technical.fix: Add a server-level 301 redirect from http:// to https:// for every URL.

technical.name: Single canonical host
technical.reason: If www and non-www both serve the site, Google sees two copies and splits signals between them.
technical.fix: 301-redirect one hostname (www or non-www) to the other and use the chosen host in all canonicals.

technical.name: Canonical tag self-referencing
technical.reason: rel=canonical tells Google which URL to index when duplicates or parameter variants exist.
technical.fix: Add a self-referencing <link rel="canonical"> in the <head> of every indexable page.

technical.name: robots.txt exists and does not block
technical.reason: robots.txt controls crawling; a blanket Disallow removes the site from Google's crawl.
technical.fix: Publish /robots.txt that allows crawling of public pages.

technical.name: robots.txt declares Sitemap
technical.reason: A Sitemap: line lets every crawler find the sitemap without Search Console.

technical.name: XML sitemap exists and is valid
technical.reason: Sitemaps help Google discover and recrawl important URLs.
technical.fix: Publish a valid XML sitemap of all indexable URLs and reference it in robots.txt.

technical.name: Sitemap accuracy
technical.reason: Sitemap URLs that do not return 200 waste crawl activity and lower trust in the sitemap.
technical.fix: Remove redirected, broken and non-indexable URLs from the sitemap.

technical.name: Sitemap completeness
technical.reason: Indexable pages missing from the sitemap are discovered later or not at all.
technical.fix: Add every indexable canonical page to the XML sitemap.

technical.name: Sitemap lastmod meaningful
technical.reason: Google uses lastmod only when it is consistently accurate; a uniform or stale date is ignored.
technical.fix: Generate lastmod from each page's real last-modified date.

technical.name: No accidental noindex
technical.reason: noindex removes a page from Google entirely.
technical.fix: Remove the noindex directive from pages that should appear in Google.

technical.name: html lang declared
technical.reason: The lang attribute tells browsers and assistive technology which language the page is in.
technical.fix: Set <html lang="en"> (or the correct language) in the page template.

technical.name: URL structure quality
technical.reason: Short, descriptive, lowercase, hyphenated URLs are easier for users and Google to understand.
technical.fix: Use short lowercase hyphenated URLs without IDs or parameters for indexable pages.

technical.name: 404 handling
technical.reason: Missing URLs must return a real 404; soft 404s and homepage redirects confuse indexing.
technical.fix: Return HTTP 404 (or 410) for URLs that do not exist.

technical.name: No orphan pages
technical.reason: Pages no other page links to are hard for users and Google to discover.
technical.fix: Link to every sitemap page from at least one relevant page or menu.

technical.name: Indexable page count vs business scope
technical.reason: A site with far fewer pages than advertised offerings cannot rank for most of them.
technical.fix: Create a page for each advertised product line or service.

on_page.name: Title present
on_page.reason: The <title> is the main source of the clickable headline in Google results.
on_page.fix: Give every page a unique, descriptive <title>.

on_page.name: Title length 30-60 characters
on_page.reason: Titles over 60 characters are truncated in results; very short titles under-describe the page.
on_page.fix: Rewrite titles to 30-60 characters with the main term first.

on_page.name: Title uniqueness
on_page.reason: Duplicate titles make pages indistinguishable in results.
on_page.fix: Write a unique title for every page.

on_page.name: Title carries primary term
on_page.reason: A brand-only or generic title does not tell Google what the page offers.
on_page.fix: Put the page's product or service term in its title.

on_page.name: Title accuracy
on_page.reason: A title naming the wrong product or brand misleads searchers.
on_page.fix: Make sure each title describes that page's actual subject.

on_page.name: Meta description present
on_page.reason: Without a description Google picks arbitrary text for the snippet.
on_page.fix: Write a meta description for every page.

on_page.name: Meta description length <= 155
on_page.reason: Descriptions over 155 characters are truncated in results.
on_page.fix: Keep descriptions at 155 characters or under, and not shorter than 70.

on_page.name: Meta description uniqueness
on_page.reason: Duplicate descriptions are less useful in results.
on_page.fix: Write a unique description for every page.

on_page.name: Exactly one H1
on_page.reason: One clear main heading states the page topic for users and Google.

on_page.name: H1 carries primary term
on_page.reason: Generic headings such as 'Welcome' or 'PRODUCTS' waste the strongest on-page signal.
on_page.fix: Rewrite each H1 to name the product or service on that page.

on_page.name: Heading hierarchy unbroken
on_page.reason: A logical H1 > H2 > H3 outline helps users and Google understand the page structure.
on_page.fix: Add H2 sections and avoid skipping heading levels.

on_page.name: Headings free of artefacts
on_page.reason: Page-builder dividers typed into heading fields (e.g. '---') pollute the headings Google reads.
on_page.fix: Remove separators and stray punctuation from heading text.

content.name: Crawlable body copy exists
content.reason: Pages with no server-rendered text give Google nothing to rank.
content.fix: Publish real text content in the HTML of every page.

content.name: Commercial page depth (400+ words)
content.reason: Thin product and service pages rarely answer what a buyer needs to know.
content.fix: Expand each product/service page with specifications, applications and FAQs.

content.name: No thin pages (<150 words)
content.reason: Several thin pages lower the overall quality signal of a site.
content.fix: Expand or consolidate pages with fewer than 150 words.

content.name: Coverage of advertised offering
content.reason: An advertised product line with no page cannot rank.
content.fix: Create a page for every product line named in the tagline or menu.

content.name: No template or placeholder copy
content.reason: Placeholder text (lorem ipsum, 'Sample Page') signals an unfinished site.
content.fix: Replace placeholder text with content written for this business.

content.name: Factual consistency (no zero-rendered statistics)
content.reason: Statistics that render as '0+' in the served HTML state something untrue to crawlers and slow-loading visitors.
content.fix: Render real figures in the HTML instead of relying on a count-up animation.

content.name: Grammar and copy quality
content.reason: Copy errors on commercial pages reduce trust.

content.name: Demonstrated expertise (technical specifics)
content.reason: Specific figures and correct terminology show expertise (Google's E-E-A-T guidance).
content.fix: Publish specifications, capacities and technical details on product/service pages.

content.name: Demonstrated experience (projects, cases)
content.reason: Named projects and case studies show first-hand experience.
content.fix: Add project references, case studies or client testimonials.

content.name: Content not locked in images
content.reason: Product information that exists only inside images is invisible to crawlers.
content.fix: Repeat product names and details as text and add descriptive alt text.

keyword.name: Primary term in title
keyword.reason: The title is the heaviest on-page placement for a search term.
keyword.fix: Include each page's main product/service term in its title.

keyword.name: Geo modifier where market is local
keyword.reason: Local buyers search with the city or country name.
keyword.fix: Add the market name (city or country) to commercial page titles.

keyword.name: Primary term in H1
keyword.reason: The H1 confirms the page topic to users and Google.
keyword.fix: Put the page's main term in its H1.

keyword.name: Term in meta description
keyword.reason: Google bolds search terms in snippets, which improves click-through.
keyword.fix: Mention the page's main term in its meta description.

keyword.name: One page per distinct intent
keyword.reason: Each commercial intent needs its own page to rank.
keyword.fix: Give each product/service intent its own page.

keyword.name: No cannibalisation
keyword.reason: Two pages targeting the same term compete with each other.
keyword.fix: Differentiate or merge pages that target the same term.

internal_linking.name: Navigation present and working
internal_linking.reason: Consistent working navigation is how users and crawlers move through a site.
internal_linking.fix: Provide a consistent menu on every page and fix broken menu links.

internal_linking.name: All key pages in navigation
internal_linking.reason: Commercial pages outside the menu receive little internal link weight.
internal_linking.fix: Add every product/service page to the menu or a linked hub page.

internal_linking.name: Contextual in-body links
internal_linking.reason: In-content links tell Google which pages matter and how they relate.
internal_linking.fix: Add at least one descriptive in-text link from each commercial page to a related page.

internal_linking.name: No orphan pages
internal_linking.reason: Orphaned pages are hard to discover and receive no internal authority.
internal_linking.fix: Link to every orphaned page from a relevant page or the menu.

internal_linking.name: Breadcrumbs
internal_linking.reason: Breadcrumbs show hierarchy to users and can appear in Google results.
internal_linking.fix: Add visible breadcrumbs (with BreadcrumbList markup) to pages below the homepage.

internal_linking.name: Descriptive anchor text
internal_linking.reason: Google uses anchor text to understand the linked page.
internal_linking.fix: Replace 'click here' and empty links with descriptive text.

image.name: Alt text coverage
image.reason: Alt text is how Google (and screen readers) understand images.
image.fix: Add short descriptive alt text to every content image.

image.name: Descriptive image filenames
image.reason: Filenames such as IMG_1234.jpg carry no meaning for image search.
image.fix: Name image files with lowercase hyphenated descriptive words.

image.name: Text equivalent for info-carrying images
image.reason: Product information that exists only in images cannot be indexed.
image.fix: Provide the same information as text and alt text.

image.name: Modern image formats
image.reason: WebP/AVIF are much smaller than JPEG/PNG at similar quality.

image.name: Image dimensions declared
image.fix: Set width and height attributes on images.

image.name: Lazy loading below the fold
image.reason: Lazy-loading offscreen images reduces initial page weight; the hero image must stay eager.
image.fix: Add loading="lazy" to below-the-fold images only.

image.name: Social share image
image.reason: og:image controls the preview image when pages are shared.
image.fix: Add og:image (and og:image:alt) to every page.

structured_data.name: Organization / LocalBusiness schema
structured_data.reason: Organization/LocalBusiness markup lets Google identify the business entity.
structured_data.fix: Add Organization or LocalBusiness JSON-LD with name, url, logo, address and phone.

structured_data.name: Vertical schema (Product / Service / Tour / Offer)
structured_data.reason: Product/Service/Tour markup describes the offerings to search engines.
structured_data.fix: Add Product, Service or TouristTrip JSON-LD to each offering page.

structured_data.name: BreadcrumbList
structured_data.reason: BreadcrumbList markup can show the site hierarchy in results.
structured_data.fix: Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD matching the visible breadcrumbs.

structured_data.name: FAQPage / Article where content exists
structured_data.reason: Existing FAQ or article content should be marked up so machines can parse it.
structured_data.fix: Add FAQPage or Article JSON-LD to the pages that contain that content.

structured_data.name: Open Graph completeness
structured_data.reason: Complete Open Graph tags control how pages appear when shared.
structured_data.fix: Set og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:site_name, og:type and og:locale.

structured_data.name: og:locale correct for market
structured_data.reason: og:locale should match the business's country.
structured_data.fix: Set og:locale to the market locale (e.g. en_LK).

structured_data.name: Twitter Card complete (summary_large_image)
structured_data.reason: summary_large_image with an image and alt gives the best preview on X.
structured_data.fix: Set twitter:card=summary_large_image with twitter:image and twitter:image:alt.

structured_data.name: Per-page Open Graph values
structured_data.reason: Identical OG values on every page make every share look the same.
structured_data.fix: Generate og:title and og:description from each page's own title and description.

mobile.name: Viewport meta correct
mobile.reason: Google indexes the mobile version; without a viewport pages render as zoomed-out desktop pages.
mobile.fix: Use <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> without disabling zoom.

mobile.name: Mobile content parity
mobile.reason: With mobile-first indexing, content missing on mobile is missing for Google.
mobile.fix: Serve the same main content to mobile and desktop.

mobile.name: Responsive layout (no horizontal scroll at 360px)
mobile.reason: Horizontal scrolling on phones is a mobile usability failure.
mobile.fix: Fix elements wider than the mobile viewport.

mobile.name: Tap-to-call
mobile.reason: Phone numbers should be tappable on mobile.
mobile.fix: Wrap every published phone number in a tel: link.

mobile.name: Tap targets >= 48x48px
mobile.reason: Small tap targets cause mis-taps on phones.
mobile.fix: Make buttons and links at least 48x48px with spacing.

mobile.name: Contact route reachable on every page
mobile.reason: A mobile visitor landing on an inner page needs a direct way to make contact.
mobile.fix: Put phone, email and a contact link in the site-wide header or footer.

page_experience.name: LCP (Largest Contentful Paint)
page_experience.reason: LCP is a Core Web Vital: good is under 2.5 s at the 75th percentile.
page_experience.fix: Optimise the hero element, server response and render-blocking resources.

page_experience.name: INP (Interaction to Next Paint)
page_experience.reason: INP is a Core Web Vital: good is under 200 ms.
page_experience.fix: Reduce long JavaScript tasks and third-party scripts.

page_experience.name: CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift)
page_experience.reason: CLS is a Core Web Vital: good is under 0.1.
page_experience.fix: Reserve space for images, embeds and late-loading content.

page_experience.name: TTFB (Time to First Byte)
page_experience.fix: Add caching / a CDN and optimise server processing.

page_experience.name: Image delivery quality (CDN + modern formats)
page_experience.reason: A CDN and modern formats are the main levers for image delivery speed.
page_experience.fix: Serve images through a CDN in WebP/AVIF.

page_experience.name: Render dependency (server-rendered content)
page_experience.reason: Content that needs JavaScript to appear may be indexed late or incompletely.
page_experience.fix: Server-render or pre-render the main content.

local.name: Business name consistent
local.reason: One consistent business name helps Google tie mentions to one entity.
local.fix: Use the identical legal business name everywhere.

local.name: Full postal address published
local.reason: A complete address (with postal code) is the base of local search visibility.
local.fix: Publish the full street address including postal code.

local.name: NAP on every page
local.reason: Name, address and phone repeated site-wide reinforce the local signal.
local.fix: Put name, address and phone in the site-wide footer.

local.name: Phone number(s) published
local.reason: Customers and Google need a published phone number.
local.fix: Publish phone numbers, ideally separated by department.

local.name: Domain email (not free webmail)
local.reason: An @own-domain email is a trust signal.
local.fix: Use an email address on your own domain.

local.name: Opening hours
local.reason: Opening hours are a core local business fact.
local.fix: Publish opening hours on the site and in LocalBusiness schema.

local.name: Locale declaration correct
local.reason: Language/locale declarations should match the business's country.
local.fix: Declare the country locale (e.g. lang="en-LK", og:locale=en_LK).

local.name: Geographic targeting in content
local.reason: Naming the cities or regions served helps local relevance.
local.fix: Mention the city/region served in page content and titles.

local.name: Google Business Profile
local.reason: A claimed, complete Google Business Profile drives map results.
local.fix: Claim and complete the Google Business Profile.

local.name: Map embed
local.reason: A map on the contact page helps visitors find the business.
local.fix: Embed a Google Map on the contact page.

local.name: LocalBusiness schema with address and hours
local.reason: LocalBusiness markup states address and hours in machine-readable form.
local.fix: Add LocalBusiness JSON-LD including address and openingHoursSpecification.

vertical:b2b_product.name: Category page per product line
vertical:b2b_product.reason: Each product line needs a category page to rank.
vertical:b2b_product.fix: Create a category page for every product line.

vertical:b2b_product.name: Individual model / product pages
vertical:b2b_product.fix: Create a page per model or product.

vertical:b2b_product.name: Specification data published
vertical:b2b_product.reason: Specification figures (capacity, power, pressure) are what B2B buyers compare.
vertical:b2b_product.fix: Publish specification tables on product pages.

vertical:b2b_product.name: Model numbers published
vertical:b2b_product.reason: Model numbers are high-intent search terms.
vertical:b2b_product.fix: Publish model numbers on product pages.

vertical:b2b_product.name: Datasheet / brochure downloads
vertical:b2b_product.fix: Link a PDF datasheet from each model page.

vertical:b2b_product.name: Pricing or quote mechanism
vertical:b2b_product.reason: Buyers need a price band or a clear way to request a quote.
vertical:b2b_product.fix: Show indicative pricing or a 'Request a quote' action.

vertical:b2b_product.name: Enquiry route from product pages
vertical:b2b_product.reason: Every product page needs a direct way to enquire.
vertical:b2b_product.fix: Add an enquiry form or tagged CTA to each product page.

vertical:b2b_product.name: Stock / lead time indication
vertical:b2b_product.fix: State ex-stock vs indent / lead time.

vertical:b2b_product.name: Brand / authorisation pages
vertical:b2b_product.reason: Represented brands are searched by name.
vertical:b2b_product.fix: Create a page per represented brand.

vertical:travel_tourism.name: Tour / package pages
vertical:travel_tourism.reason: Each tour needs its own page to rank and convert.
vertical:travel_tourism.fix: Create a page per tour or package.

vertical:travel_tourism.name: Itinerary detail (day-by-day)
vertical:travel_tourism.reason: Day-by-day itineraries answer the main traveller question.
vertical:travel_tourism.fix: Publish a day-by-day itinerary on each tour page.

vertical:travel_tourism.name: Duration, group size, departure points
vertical:travel_tourism.reason: Practical tour facts help travellers decide.
vertical:travel_tourism.fix: State duration, group size and pick-up/departure points.

vertical:travel_tourism.name: Price or price-from
vertical:travel_tourism.reason: A price or price-from sets expectations.
vertical:travel_tourism.fix: Show a price or 'from' price on tour pages.

vertical:travel_tourism.name: Inclusions / exclusions
vertical:travel_tourism.fix: List what is and is not included.

vertical:travel_tourism.name: Destination / region pages
vertical:travel_tourism.reason: Destination pages capture 'things to do in …' searches.

vertical:travel_tourism.name: Booking or enquiry route per tour
vertical:travel_tourism.reason: Each tour page needs a booking or enquiry action.
vertical:travel_tourism.fix: Add a booking/enquiry button or form to every tour page.

vertical:travel_tourism.name: Gallery with described imagery
vertical:travel_tourism.reason: Described photos help image search and accessibility.
vertical:travel_tourism.fix: Add alt text to gallery images.

vertical:travel_tourism.name: Reviews / third-party ratings surfaced
vertical:travel_tourism.reason: Reviews are a major trust factor for travel bookings.
vertical:travel_tourism.fix: Show TripAdvisor/Google reviews on the site.

vertical:travel_tourism.name: Operator licence / association membership
vertical:travel_tourism.fix: Publish licence numbers and association memberships.

vertical:ecommerce.name: Products & prices in HTML
vertical:ecommerce.reason: Product cards and pages must serve visible currency prices in the HTML for search engines and shoppers.
vertical:ecommerce.fix: Display prices in HTML on every product card and product page.

vertical:ecommerce.name: Product descriptions
vertical:ecommerce.reason: Product pages with only specification bullet lists have no unique prose for search engines to rank.
vertical:ecommerce.fix: Write 2-4 sentences of original descriptive prose above or below specifications on product pages.

vertical:ecommerce.name: Specifications published
vertical:ecommerce.reason: Technical specifications (ratings, dimensions, standards, warranty) give buyers the facts they need to purchase.
vertical:ecommerce.fix: Publish structured specifications with ratings, standards, dimensions and warranty on product pages.

vertical:ecommerce.name: Stock status
vertical:ecommerce.reason: Clear in-stock indication confirms product availability to shoppers and search engines.
vertical:ecommerce.fix: State stock availability ('In Stock' / 'Out of Stock') clearly on product pages.

vertical:ecommerce.name: Category copy
vertical:ecommerce.reason: Category and brand archive pages need 150-300 words of introductory buying copy to rank for high-volume category searches.
vertical:ecommerce.fix: Add 150-300 words of informative buying copy and FAQs to each main category and brand page.

vertical:ecommerce.name: Correct categorisation
vertical:ecommerce.reason: Default or 'Uncategorized' pages exposed to indexing look untidy and miss proper keyword categorization.
vertical:ecommerce.fix: Assign all products to descriptive categories and noindex or remove the 'Uncategorized' category.

vertical:ecommerce.name: Reviews & ratings
vertical:ecommerce.reason: Customer reviews and store ratings build trust and provide fresh user-generated content.
vertical:ecommerce.fix: Collect and display customer reviews and ratings on product pages.

vertical:ecommerce.name: Delivery & returns terms
vertical:ecommerce.reason: Delivery timescales, shipping fees, and return policies must be clearly accessible on their own dedicated page.
vertical:ecommerce.fix: Publish a dedicated Delivery & Returns page with timeframes, fees, and return conditions.

vertical:ecommerce.name: Filter pages controlled
vertical:ecommerce.reason: Faceted navigation and filter parameters must canonicalise to the clean archive URL to prevent index dilution.
vertical:ecommerce.fix: Self-canonicalise clean category URLs and canonicalise filter/sort parameters to the clean URL.

vertical:ecommerce.name: Out-of-stock handling / Catalogue accuracy
vertical:ecommerce.reason: Sitemap listings must match the browseable catalogue so crawlers are not sent to dead or deleted items.
vertical:ecommerce.fix: Keep sitemaps synchronized with the active product catalogue.

vertical:ecommerce_retail.name: Products & prices in HTML
vertical:ecommerce_retail.reason: Product cards and pages must serve visible currency prices in the HTML for search engines and shoppers.
vertical:ecommerce_retail.fix: Display prices in HTML on every product card and product page.

vertical:ecommerce_retail.name: Product descriptions
vertical:ecommerce_retail.reason: Product pages with only specification bullet lists have no unique prose for search engines to rank.
vertical:ecommerce_retail.fix: Write 2-4 sentences of original descriptive prose above or below specifications on product pages.

vertical:ecommerce_retail.name: Specifications published
vertical:ecommerce_retail.reason: Technical specifications (ratings, dimensions, standards, warranty) give buyers the facts they need to purchase.
vertical:ecommerce_retail.fix: Publish structured specifications with ratings, standards, dimensions and warranty on product pages.

vertical:ecommerce_retail.name: Stock status
vertical:ecommerce_retail.reason: Clear in-stock indication confirms product availability to shoppers and search engines.
vertical:ecommerce_retail.fix: State stock availability ('In Stock' / 'Out of Stock') clearly on product pages.

vertical:ecommerce_retail.name: Category copy
vertical:ecommerce_retail.reason: Category and brand archive pages need 150-300 words of introductory buying copy to rank for high-volume category searches.
vertical:ecommerce_retail.fix: Add 150-300 words of informative buying copy and FAQs to each main category and brand page.

vertical:ecommerce_retail.name: Correct categorisation
vertical:ecommerce_retail.reason: Default or 'Uncategorized' pages exposed to indexing look untidy and miss proper keyword categorization.
vertical:ecommerce_retail.fix: Assign all products to descriptive categories and noindex or remove the 'Uncategorized' category.

vertical:ecommerce_retail.name: Reviews & ratings
vertical:ecommerce_retail.reason: Customer reviews and store ratings build trust and provide fresh user-generated content.
vertical:ecommerce_retail.fix: Collect and display customer reviews and ratings on product pages.

vertical:ecommerce_retail.name: Delivery & returns terms
vertical:ecommerce_retail.reason: Delivery timescales, shipping fees, and return policies must be clearly accessible on their own dedicated page.
vertical:ecommerce_retail.fix: Publish a dedicated Delivery & Returns page with timeframes, fees, and return conditions.

vertical:ecommerce_retail.name: Filter pages controlled
vertical:ecommerce_retail.reason: Faceted navigation and filter parameters must canonicalise to the clean archive URL to prevent index dilution.
vertical:ecommerce_retail.fix: Self-canonicalise clean category URLs and canonicalise filter/sort parameters to the clean URL.

vertical:ecommerce_retail.name: Out-of-stock handling / Catalogue accuracy
vertical:ecommerce_retail.reason: Sitemap listings must match the browseable catalogue so crawlers are not sent to dead or deleted items.
vertical:ecommerce_retail.fix: Keep sitemaps synchronized with the active product catalogue.

vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.name: Asset specifications
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.reason: Asset pages require version, resolution, file size, plugins, and aspect ratio specifications.
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.fix: Display full technical specifications on all asset pages.

vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.name: Asset descriptions
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.reason: Short 20-word asset descriptions provide insufficient context for search engines.
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.fix: Expand asset descriptions to 60-120 words describing use cases, editing steps, and features.

vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.name: Preview media
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.reason: Video/audio preview players or video sitemaps allow search engines to index preview assets.
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.fix: Provide server-rendered preview media and video sitemaps for all assets.

vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.name: Licence clarity
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.reason: Licence terms must be clear, consistent, and free of contradictions across plan cards and FAQs.
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.fix: Harmonize licence descriptions and cancellation terms across all pages.

vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.name: Hub copy & items
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.reason: Category hubs serving empty grids in HTML without introductory copy cannot rank.
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.fix: Server-render 24-48 items in the HTML and add 150-300 words of introductory copy and FAQs.

vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.name: Sub-category pages
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.reason: Sub-categories must not be trapped in blocked query-string URLs (?subcategory=).
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.fix: Create clean URL paths for each sub-category with unique titles and copy.

vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.name: Free-assets hub
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.reason: A free tier without a dedicated crawlable landing page fails to capture high-volume free search intent.
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.fix: Create dedicated /free landing pages for each asset category.

vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.name: Genuine social proof
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.reason: Placeholder reviews, fake ratings, or repeated student counts undermine trust and violate search quality guidelines.
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.fix: Remove hardcoded placeholder ratings and display only verified reviews.

vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.name: Related assets
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.reason: Related templates or assets should be rendered in server HTML to strengthen internal linking.
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.fix: Server-render 6-8 related assets on each asset template.

vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.name: Pricing consistency
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.reason: Discount badges ('50% OFF') without a reference monthly price confuse buyers and invite disputes.
vertical:digital_asset_marketplace.fix: State pricing and savings transparently with reference pricing.

conversion.name: Phone reachable from every page
conversion.reason: A visitor landing on any page must be able to call.
conversion.fix: Show the phone number as a tel: link in the site-wide header or footer.

conversion.name: Enquiry form exists
conversion.reason: Without a form, visitors who will not call cannot enquire.

conversion.name: Form captures an email address
conversion.reason: Without an email field you cannot send quotes or documents in writing.
conversion.fix: Add a required email field to the enquiry form.

conversion.name: Form carries page/product context
conversion.reason: Enquiries that arrive without the product the visitor was viewing slow down sales.
conversion.fix: Pre-fill or pre-select the product from the page the visitor came from.

conversion.name: Email link present
conversion.reason: A CTA that invites an email must give an address.
conversion.fix: Publish the email address as a mailto: link wherever email contact is invited.

conversion.name: Messaging channel (WhatsApp etc.)
conversion.reason: Many buyers prefer messaging over calls or forms.

conversion.name: All CTAs functional
conversion.fix: Point every call-to-action at a working page, form or contact link.

conversion.name: Pricing expectation set
conversion.reason: A price, band or explicit quote process sets buyer expectations.
conversion.fix: Show indicative prices or explain the quote process.

conversion.name: Conversion tracking in place
conversion.reason: Without tracking you cannot see which pages produce enquiries.
conversion.fix: Install GA4 and track form submits, phone and chat clicks as events.

vertical:agency_services.name: Dedicated service landing pages
vertical:agency_services.reason: Each core service offering needs its own dedicated landing page to rank for service queries.
vertical:agency_services.fix: Create a dedicated landing page for each core service offering.

vertical:agency_services.name: Service descriptions & scope
vertical:agency_services.reason: Service pages must explain the methodology, process, and deliverables clearly.
vertical:agency_services.fix: Add detailed prose explaining service deliverables, process, and scope.

vertical:agency_services.name: Portfolio & case studies
vertical:agency_services.reason: Documented client projects and results demonstrate expertise (E-E-A-T).
vertical:agency_services.fix: Publish detailed case studies showcasing client challenges, actions, and measurable outcomes.

vertical:agency_services.name: Clear deliverables & methodology
vertical:agency_services.reason: Explaining the step-by-step engagement process builds trust and conversion readiness.
vertical:agency_services.fix: Detail your service methodology or 3-step process on service pages.

vertical:agency_services.name: Service enquiry & consultation CTA
vertical:agency_services.reason: Every service page must feature a clear call-to-action to book a consultation or request a proposal.
vertical:agency_services.fix: Add a prominent 'Book Consultation' or 'Request Proposal' CTA to each service page.

vertical:agency_services.name: Client testimonials & social proof
vertical:agency_services.reason: Named client reviews and quotes build confidence for prospective clients.
vertical:agency_services.fix: Feature authentic client testimonials and reviews on service pages and the homepage.

vertical:agency_services.name: Transparent quote request / pricing
vertical:agency_services.reason: Indicative pricing, packages, or a structured quote form sets client expectations.
vertical:agency_services.fix: Provide package tiers or a structured proposal request form.

vertical:agency_services.name: Target industries & specializations
vertical:agency_services.reason: Highlighting industry specializations (e.g. B2B, eCommerce, Healthcare) captures niche searches.
vertical:agency_services.fix: Highlight the specific industries or company sizes your agency serves.

vertical:agency_services.name: Technology stack & platform expertise
vertical:agency_services.reason: Listing certified tools, stacks, and partner platforms captures platform-specific search intent.
vertical:agency_services.fix: List supported technologies, CMSs, and platforms with official badges.

vertical:agency_services.name: Enquiry form carries service context
vertical:agency_services.reason: Forms pre-selecting the requested service reduce sales friction.
vertical:agency_services.fix: Pre-select or pass the viewed service name into the consultation enquiry form.

vertical:software_saas.name: Dedicated solution & feature pages
vertical:software_saas.reason: Each primary software module or solution requires a dedicated crawlable page.
vertical:software_saas.fix: Create dedicated landing pages for core software features and use cases.

vertical:software_saas.name: Product capabilities & technical specs
vertical:software_saas.reason: Technical specifications and capability details help software buyers evaluate fit.
vertical:software_saas.fix: Detail supported platforms, requirements, and feature limits on feature pages.

vertical:software_saas.name: Product screenshots & demo media
vertical:software_saas.reason: Visual screenshots, product UI tours, and video previews communicate value immediately.
vertical:software_saas.fix: Embed crisp UI screenshots with descriptive alt tags and feature callouts.

vertical:software_saas.name: Transparent pricing tiers / plans
vertical:software_saas.reason: Software buyers expect a dedicated pricing page comparing plan tiers and features.
vertical:software_saas.fix: Publish a dedicated /pricing page with clear feature comparison tables.

vertical:software_saas.name: Free trial or demo signup CTA
vertical:software_saas.reason: Direct action paths (Start Free Trial or Request Demo) are vital for SaaS conversion.
vertical:software_saas.fix: Include sticky or prominent Free Trial / Demo buttons in the header and page sections.

vertical:software_saas.name: Security & compliance documentation
vertical:software_saas.reason: Enterprise software buyers search for SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA, and data protection credentials.
vertical:software_saas.fix: Publish a dedicated security, compliance, and data privacy overview page.

vertical:software_saas.name: Integrations & API documentation
vertical:software_saas.reason: Third-party integrations and developer API docs capture high-intent software integration searches.
vertical:software_saas.fix: Create an /integrations directory highlighting connected apps and API access.

vertical:software_saas.name: Customer success stories / case studies
vertical:software_saas.reason: Real customer stories with ROI figures validate product claims.
vertical:software_saas.fix: Publish customer success stories highlighting metrics and customer testimonials.

vertical:software_saas.name: Knowledge base / documentation access
vertical:software_saas.reason: Public help center and docs capture long-tail technical queries.
vertical:software_saas.fix: Provide links to public knowledge base, documentation, and user guides.

vertical:software_saas.name: Direct onboarding route
vertical:software_saas.reason: Frictionless signup or registration flows convert organic traffic effectively.
vertical:software_saas.fix: Ensure the signup link or demo form is functional and linked sitewide.

vertical:local_services.name: Service area & location pages
vertical:local_services.reason: Local businesses must target the specific cities and suburbs they serve.
vertical:local_services.fix: Create landing pages for each primary service area or city served.

vertical:local_services.name: Service scope & descriptions
vertical:local_services.reason: Explaining specific services provided in the locality improves local relevance.
vertical:local_services.fix: Publish detailed descriptions of each trade service provided.

vertical:local_services.name: Direct phone & emergency contact route
vertical:local_services.reason: Local customers frequently need immediate phone contact.
vertical:local_services.fix: Display a tap-to-call phone number in the mobile header and footer.

vertical:local_services.name: Instant booking / quote mechanism
vertical:local_services.reason: An online estimate request form captures leads after business hours.
vertical:local_services.fix: Provide a simple online booking or quote request form.

vertical:local_services.name: Customer reviews & local ratings
vertical:local_services.reason: Local customer reviews build community trust and local pack authority.
vertical:local_services.fix: Feature Google and local customer reviews on the website.

vertical:local_services.name: Trade licenses & certifications
vertical:local_services.reason: Displaying official license numbers and insurance builds consumer trust.
vertical:local_services.fix: State contractor license numbers, insurance, and trade associations in the footer.

vertical:local_services.name: Transparent pricing / call-out terms
vertical:local_services.reason: Clear call-out fee or hourly rate expectations reduce enquiry hesitation.
vertical:local_services.fix: State pricing policy, call-out rates, or free estimate terms clearly.

vertical:local_services.name: Service gallery & recent local work
vertical:local_services.reason: Photos of completed local jobs with descriptive alt text prove first-hand experience.
vertical:local_services.fix: Add a photo gallery of recent local projects with descriptive captions.

vertical:local_services.name: Frequently asked questions (FAQs)
vertical:local_services.reason: Local service FAQs address common customer concerns and capture question queries.
vertical:local_services.fix: Add an FAQ section addressing service warranties, response times, and payment.

vertical:local_services.name: Local business guarantees / warranties
vertical:local_services.reason: Stated satisfaction guarantees reassure local homeowners and buyers.
vertical:local_services.fix: Publish your workmanship warranty or satisfaction guarantee policy.

vertical:publisher_blog.name: Category and topic archive hubs
vertical:publisher_blog.reason: Topic archive hubs establish topical authority and cluster related editorial content.
vertical:publisher_blog.fix: Create structured category archive pages with introductory editorial copy.

vertical:publisher_blog.name: Author bylines and profile pages
vertical:publisher_blog.reason: Author bylines and bio pages with credentials are vital for Google E-E-A-T.
vertical:publisher_blog.fix: Link author bylines to dedicated author profiles stating expertise and social profiles.

vertical:publisher_blog.name: Article publication & update dates
vertical:publisher_blog.reason: Freshness signals and visible published/modified dates are critical for news and blogs.
vertical:publisher_blog.fix: Display visible published and last updated dates with article schema.

vertical:publisher_blog.name: Editorial standards & corrections
vertical:publisher_blog.reason: Published editorial guidelines and fact-checking policies build publication credibility.
vertical:publisher_blog.fix: Publish an editorial standards, ethics, and corrections policy page.

vertical:publisher_blog.name: Newsletter subscription & RSS feeds
vertical:publisher_blog.reason: Email newsletters and RSS feeds drive recurring readership and subscriber loyalty.
vertical:publisher_blog.fix: Provide prominent newsletter signup CTAs and an RSS feed link.

vertical:publisher_blog.name: Related articles & topic navigation
vertical:publisher_blog.reason: Related post recommendations lower bounce rate and distribute internal link equity.
vertical:publisher_blog.fix: Display 3-4 related articles at the end of each post.

vertical:publisher_blog.name: Comments or reader engagement
vertical:publisher_blog.reason: Reader comments and community engagement provide fresh user-generated content.
vertical:publisher_blog.fix: Enable moderated comments or community discussion on editorial posts.

vertical:publisher_blog.name: Featured imagery & photo captions
vertical:publisher_blog.reason: Original editorial photos with captions and credits improve Discover and Image search.
vertical:publisher_blog.fix: Use high-resolution featured images with descriptive captions and credits.

vertical:publisher_blog.name: Social sharing integration
vertical:publisher_blog.reason: Easy social share buttons expand article reach across social channels.
vertical:publisher_blog.fix: Add lightweight social share buttons on all article templates.

vertical:publisher_blog.name: Table of contents on in-depth guides
vertical:publisher_blog.reason: Jump links and table of contents on 1,500+ word guides improve user experience.
vertical:publisher_blog.fix: Add a clickable table of contents with anchor links on long-form guides.

vertical:general.name: About and leadership overview
vertical:general.reason: An informative About page with team/company background establishes trust.
vertical:general.fix: Publish an About page introducing the organization, mission, and leadership.

vertical:general.name: Offerings / solutions overview pages
vertical:general.reason: Core solutions and offerings need distinct crawlable pages to be indexed.
vertical:general.fix: Create a distinct landing page for each core service, product, or solution.

vertical:general.name: Primary conversion & contact routes
vertical:general.reason: Visitors must have direct access to contact and enquiry mechanisms on every page.
vertical:general.fix: Include contact details or link to contact in the header/footer of every page.

vertical:general.name: Trust signals & credentials
vertical:general.reason: Industry memberships, security badges, and credentials enhance brand authority.
vertical:general.fix: Display affiliations, certifications, or partner credentials on key pages.

vertical:general.name: News, updates or company insights
vertical:general.reason: Recent news or blog updates show an active, maintaining organization.
vertical:general.fix: Publish company news, press releases, or informative blog articles regularly.

vertical:general.name: Clear navigation & sitemap discoverability
vertical:general.reason: Clear menu navigation allows users and search bots to discover all sections.
vertical:general.fix: Provide a clean, logical navigation structure with working menu links.

vertical:general.name: Legal policies & compliance pages
vertical:general.reason: Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are standard web trust requirements.
vertical:general.fix: Publish crawlable Privacy Policy and Terms of Service pages linked in the footer.

vertical:general.name: Branded imagery & identity consistency
vertical:general.reason: Consistent branding and logo files reinforce domain entity authority.
vertical:general.fix: Use consistent high-quality brand logos with descriptive alt text.

vertical:general.name: Search or directory access
vertical:general.reason: On-site search or quick directory links help visitors locate specific content.
vertical:general.fix: Provide a site search box or comprehensive footer directory.

vertical:general.name: Social profile connections
vertical:general.reason: Linking verified company social profiles reinforces brand entity signals.
vertical:general.fix: Link official company social profiles (LinkedIn, X, YouTube, etc.) in the footer.
